title.zh: 卷四十七 本紀第四十七: 順帝十
title.raw: 卷四十七 本紀第四十七: 順帝十 Volume 47 Annals 47: Shundi 10

sentences.zh: 順帝十

translations.literal: Shundi 10
translations.idiomatic: Shundi 10

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月己酉，以崇政院使孛羅沙為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year, spring, first month, jiyou day; Bolosha, commissioner of the Court for the Promotion of Governance, was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, on the jiyou day of the first month of spring, Bolosha, commissioner of the Court for the Promotion of Governance, was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以完者木知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On renzi day, Wanje was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day, Wanje was appointed director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是月，以沙藍答裏為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: That month, Shalandari was appointed left chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shalandari was appointed left chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 命燕南、河南、山東、陜西、河東等處舉人會試者，增其額數，進士及第以下遞升官一級。

translations.literal: An order was issued that in Yannan, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Hedong, and other circuits, candidates sitting the metropolitan examination should have their quotas increased, and all who passed as jinshi or below should be promoted one rank in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Candidates from Yannan, Henan, Shandong, Shaanxi, Hedong, and other circuits who took the metropolitan examination were to have their quotas increased, and every graduate from jinshi downward was to be promoted one rank in turn.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑朔，立河淮水軍元帥府於孟津縣。

translations.literal: Second month, guichou new moon; the Grand Marshal's Office of the Yellow and Huai River Naval Forces was established at Mengjin County.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon of guichou, the Grand Marshal's Office of the Yellow and Huai River Naval Forces was established at Mengjin County.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔天下，以比者逆臣孛羅帖木兒、禿堅帖木兒、老的沙等幹紀亂倫，內外之民經值軍馬，致使困乏，與免一切雜泛差徭。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, an edict was issued to all under Heaven: because the rebel ministers Bolad Temür, Tuq Temür, and Laod Sha had violated discipline and disrupted proper order, and because the people within and without had suffered hardship when armies passed through, all miscellaneous levies and corvée duties were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day an edict went out to all under Heaven: the rebel ministers Bolad Temür, Tuq Temür, and Laod Sha had violated discipline and disrupted proper order, and because civilians everywhere had been exhausted when armies passed through, all miscellaneous levies and corvée duties were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，擴廓帖木兒還河南，分立省部以自隨，尋居懷慶，又居彰德，調度各處軍馬，陜西張良弼拒命。

translations.literal: That month, Köke Temür returned to Henan, set up a separate provincial administration to accompany him, soon resided at Huaiqing, then at Zhangde, and deployed troops from various places; Zhang Liangbi in Shaanxi refused orders.
translations.idiomatic: That month Köke Temür returned to Henan, established a separate provincial staff to accompany him, soon moved to Huaiqing and then Zhangde, and began deploying troops from various regions, while Zhang Liangbi in Shaanxi refused to obey orders.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未朔，罷洛陽嵩縣宣慰司。

translations.literal: Third month, guiwei new moon; the Pacification Commission of Song County in Luoyang was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of guiwei, the Pacification Commission of Song County in Luoyang was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，白虹五道亙天，其第三道貫日，又有氣橫貫東南，良久始滅。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, five white rainbows stretched across the sky; the third pierced the sun, and a vapor also ran horizontally across the southeast before vanishing after a long while.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day five white rainbows stretched across the sky; the third pierced the sun, and a band of vapor also ran horizontally across the southeast before finally dissipating.

sentences.zh: 甲午，擴廓帖木兒遣關保、虎林赤以兵西攻張良弼於鹿臺。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Köke Temür sent Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan with troops west to attack Zhang Liangbi at Lutai.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Köke Temür sent Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan west with troops to attack Zhang Liangbi at Lutai.

sentences.zh: 李思齊、脫烈伯、孔興等兵皆與良弼合。

translations.literal: The armies of Li Siqi, Toliber, Kong Xing, and others all joined with Liangbi.
translations.idiomatic: The armies of Li Siqi, Toliber, Kong Xing, and others all joined Zhang Liangbi's forces.

sentences.zh: 以蠻子、脫脫木兒知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Manzi and Totoγan were appointed directors of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Manzi and Totoγan were appointed directors of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乙未，廷試進士七十二人，賜赫德溥化、張棟進士及第，余出身有差。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, the palace examination was held for seventy-two jinshi; Hede Puhua and Zhang Dong were granted jinshi with honors, and the rest received degrees in descending order.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day seventy-two candidates sat the palace examination; Hede Puhua and Zhang Dong were named jinshi with honors, and the rest received degrees in descending order.

sentences.zh: 監察御史玉倫普建言八事：一曰用賢，二曰申嚴宿衛，三曰保全臣子，四曰八衛屯田，五曰禁止奏請，六曰培養人才，七曰罪人不孥，八曰重惜名爵。

translations.literal: Supervising censor Yulunpu submitted eight proposals: first, employ the worthy; second, tighten night watch in the palace guard; third, preserve ministers and subjects; fourth, garrison farming by the Eight Guards; fifth, forbid improper memorials; sixth, cultivate talent; seventh, do not extend punishment to offenders' families; eighth, value titles and ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor Yulunpu submitted eight proposals: employ the worthy; tighten palace night watch; preserve ministers and subjects; garrison farming by the Eight Guards; forbid improper memorials; cultivate talent; do not extend punishment to offenders' families; and value titles and ranks.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: The emperor praised and accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised and accepted them.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取高郵府。

translations.literal: That month, Ming forces took Gaoyou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces captured Gaoyou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉，詔立皇太子妃瓦只剌孫答裏氏。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinyou day; an edict installed the heir apparent's consort, of the Wazilasun Dali clan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the xinyou day, an edict installed the heir apparent's consort of the Wazilasun Dali clan.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取淮安路、徐州、宿州、濠州、泗州、潁州、安豐路。

translations.literal: That month, Ming forces took Huaian Circuit, Xuzhou, Suzhou, Haozhou, Sizhou, Yingzhou, and Anfeng Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces captured Huaian Circuit, Xuzhou, Suzhou, Haozhou, Sizhou, Yingzhou, and Anfeng Circuit.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午朔，洛陽瑞麥生，一莖四穗。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renwu new moon; auspicious wheat appeared in Luoyang, one stalk with four ears.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of renwu, auspicious wheat appeared in Luoyang, one stalk bearing four ears.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以脫脫不花為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Totoγan Buhua was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day Totoγan Buhua was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子朔，汾州介休縣地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, renzi new moon; Jiezhou Jiexiu County was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of renzi, Jiexiu County in Fenzhou was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 平遙縣大雨雹。

translations.literal: Pingyao County was struck by heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: Pingyao County was struck by heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 紹興路山陰縣臥龍山裂。

translations.literal: Wolong Mountain in Shanyin County, Shaoxing Circuit, split open.
translations.idiomatic: Wolong Mountain in Shanyin County on the Shaoxing Circuit split open.

sentences.zh: 己未，命知樞密院事買閭以兵守直沽，命河間鹽運使拜住、曹履亨撫諭沿海竈戶，俾出丁夫從買閭征討。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Maimun was ordered to hold Zhigu with troops; the Hejian salt transport commissioner Baizhu and Cao Lüheng were ordered to reassure coastal salt households along the coast and have them furnish laborers to follow Maimun on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Maimun was ordered to hold Zhigu with troops; the Hejian salt transport commissioner Baizhu and Cao Lüheng were ordered to reassure coastal salt households and furnish laborers to follow Maimun on campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔：「英宗時謀為不軌之臣，其子孫或成丁者，可安置舊地，幼者隨母居草地，終身不得入京城及不得授官，止許於本愛馬應役。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, an edict stated: "For ministers who plotted sedition in Emperor Yingzong's time, if their sons or grandsons have come of age they may be settled in their former lands; the young shall dwell with their mothers on the pastures and shall never enter the capital or receive office, but may serve only in their original horse districts."
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day an edict stated: "For ministers who plotted sedition in Emperor Yingzong's time, grown sons and grandsons may be settled in their former lands; the young shall dwell with their mothers on the pastures, never enter the capital, never receive office, and may serve only in their original horse districts."

sentences.zh: 」皇后肅良合氏生日，百官進箋，皇后諭沙藍答裏等曰：「自世祖以來，正宮皇后壽日，不曾進箋，近年雖行，不合典故。

translations.literal: On the birthday of Empress Sulgan He, the hundred officials presented a congratulatory memorial; the empress told Shalandari and others: "Since the time of Shizu, the principal palace empress's birthday has never received such a memorial; though it has been done in recent years, it does not accord with precedent."
translations.idiomatic: On Empress Sulgan He's birthday the hundred officials presented a congratulatory memorial; the empress told Shalandari and others: "Since Shizu's reign the principal palace empress's birthday has never received such a memorial; though it has been done in recent years, it does not accord with precedent."

sentences.zh: 」卻之。

translations.literal: She declined it.
translations.idiomatic: She declined it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinsi new moon; there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the new moon of xinsi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 徐溝縣地震，介休縣大水，石州大星如鬥自西南而落。

translations.literal: Xugou County was shaken by earthquake; Jiexiu County suffered great flood; in Shizhou a great star like a dipper fell from the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: Xugou County was shaken by earthquake; Jiexiu County suffered severe flooding; in Shizhou a great star like a dipper fell from the southwest.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以李思齊為太尉。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, Li Siqi was appointed grand preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day Li Siqi was appointed grand preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太白經天。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 丙申，擴廓帖木兒遣朱珍、盧旺屯兵河中，遣關保、虎林赤合兵渡河，會竹貞、商暠，且約李思齊以攻張良弼。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Köke Temür sent Zhu Zhen and Lu Wang to station troops in the central region of the river, sent Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan to cross the river in combined force with Zhu Zhen and Shang Shao, and arranged with Li Siqi to attack Zhang Liangbi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Köke Temür sent Zhu Zhen and Lu Wang to station troops in the central region of the river, sent Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan to cross the river and join Zhu Zhen and Shang Shao, and arranged with Li Siqi to attack Zhang Liangbi.

sentences.zh: 良弼遣子弟質於思齊，與良弼拒守。

translations.literal: Liangbi sent his sons and younger brothers as hostages to Siqi and, together with Liangbi, held out in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Liangbi sent his sons and younger brothers as hostages to Siqi and, together with Liangbi, held out on the defensive.

sentences.zh: 關保等不利，思齊請詔和解之。

translations.literal: Guan Bao and the others fared badly; Siqi requested an edict to make peace.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bao and the others fared badly, and Siqi requested an edict to make peace.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白經天。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Venus again crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Venus again crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 八月戊寅，以李國鳳為中書左丞，陳有定為福建行省平章政事。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuyin day; Li Guofeng was appointed left vice chief minister of the Secretariat, and Chen Youding was appointed chief minister of the Fujian Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the wuyin day, Li Guofeng was appointed left vice chief minister of the Secretariat and Chen Youding chief minister of the Fujian branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，李思齊兵下鹽井，獲川賊余繼隆，誅之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiashen day; Li Siqi's army took Yanjing, captured the Sichuan bandit Yu Jilong, and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the jiashen day, Li Siqi's army took Yanjing, captured the Sichuan bandit Yu Jilong, and executed him.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎滿尚賓、吏部侍郎掩篤剌哈自鳳翔還京師。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Man Shangbin and Vice Minister of Personnel Yan Dulaqa returned to the capital from Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Vice minister of rites Man Shangbin and vice minister of personnel Yan Dulaqa returned to the capital from Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 先是，尚賓等持詔諭思齊開通川蜀道路，思齊方兵爭，不奉詔，尚賓等留鳳翔一年，至是始還。

translations.literal: Earlier, Shangbin and the others had carried an edict instructing Siqi to open routes into Sichuan; Siqi was then engaged in military contention and did not obey the edict; Shangbin and the others remained at Fengxiang for a year and only now returned.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Shangbin and the others had carried an edict instructing Siqi to open routes into Sichuan; Siqi was then fighting and did not obey; Shangbin and the others had remained at Fengxiang for a year and only now returned.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以方國珍為江浙行省左丞相，弟國瑛、國瑉，侄明善，並為江浙行省平章政事。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Fang Guozhen was appointed left chief minister of the Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat; his brothers Guoying and Guomin and his nephew Mingshan were all appointed chief ministers of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Fang Guozhen was appointed left chief minister of the Jiangzhe branch secretariat; his brothers Guoying and Guomin and his nephew Mingshan were all appointed branch chief ministers as well.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以中書平章政事失列門為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Secretariat chief minister Shiremen was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Secretariat chief minister Shiremen was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，孛星見東北方。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, a comet appeared in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day a comet appeared in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，擴廓帖木兒遣其弟脫因帖木兒及貊高、完哲等駐兵濟南，以控制山東。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiazi day; Köke Temür sent his younger brother Toyin Temür together with Mo Gao, Wanje, and others to station troops at Jinan to control Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiazi day, Köke Temür sent his younger brother Toyin Temür together with Mo Gao, Wanje, and others to station troops at Jinan to control Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，大明兵取湖州路。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiashen day; Ming forces took Huzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the jiashen day, Ming forces captured Huzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大明兵取杭州路及紹興路。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Ming forces took Hangzhou Circuit and Shaoxing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Ming forces captured Hangzhou Circuit and Shaoxing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大明兵取嘉興路。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Ming forces took Jiaxing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Ming forces captured Jiaxing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時湖州、杭州、紹興、嘉興、松江、平江諸路及無錫州皆張士誠所據。

translations.literal: At that time Huzhou, Hangzhou, Shaoxing, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Pingjiang circuits and Wuxi Prefecture were all held by Zhang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Huzhou, Hangzhou, Shaoxing, Jiaxing, Songjiang, Pingjiang circuits and Wuxi Prefecture were all held by Zhang Shicheng.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，蒲城洛水和順崖崩。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengwu day; the Heshun cliff on the Luo River at Pucheng collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the gengwu day, the Heshun cliff on the Luo River at Pucheng collapsed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月乙未，絳州夜聞天鼓鳴，將旦復鳴，其聲如空中戰鬥者。

translations.literal: Twenty-seventh year, spring, first month, yiwei day; at night Jiangzhou heard the sky-drum sound; at dawn it sounded again, like combat in the air.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, on the yiwei day of the first month of spring, Jiangzhou at night heard the sky-drum sound; at dawn it sounded again, like fighting in the air.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大明兵取松江府。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Ming forces took Songjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day Ming forces captured Songjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大明兵取沅州路。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Ming forces took Yuanzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Ming forces captured Yuanzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 是月，李思齊、張良弼、脫列伯自會於含元殿基，推李思齊為盟主，同拒擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: That month, Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and Toliber met on their own at the site of the Hanyuan Hall foundation, acclaimed Li Siqi as league leader, and together resisted Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and Toliber met on their own at the site of the Hanyuan Hall foundation, acclaimed Li Siqi as league leader, and together resisted Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，以買住為雲國公，七十為中書平章政事，月魯不花為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Second month, gengshen day; Maizhu was enfeoffed as Duke of Yunguo; Qishi was appointed Secretariat chief minister; Yelu Buhua was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the gengshen day, Maizhu was enfeoffed as Duke of Yunguo; Qishi was appointed Secretariat chief minister; and Yelu Buhua was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以詹事月魯帖木兒為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On yichou day, the household of the heir apparent's tutor Yelu Temür was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Yelu Temür of the heir apparent's household was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑朔，萊州大風，有大鳥至，其翅如席。

translations.literal: Third month, dingchou new moon; Laizhou suffered a great wind, and a great bird arrived whose wings were like mats.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the new moon of dingchou, Laizhou suffered a great wind and a huge bird arrived whose wings were like mats.

sentences.zh: 擴廓帖木兒遣兵屯滕州以禦王信。

translations.literal: Köke Temür sent troops to garrison at Tengzhou to guard against Wang Xin.
translations.idiomatic: Köke Temür sent troops to garrison at Tengzhou to guard against Wang Xin.

sentences.zh: 庚子，京師大風自西北起，飛砂揚礫，白日昏暗。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, a great wind rose in the capital from the northwest, whirling sand and flinging stones; the bright day turned dim.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day a great wind rose in the capital from the northwest, whirling sand and flinging stones until the bright day turned dim.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔，白氣二道亙天。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingzi new moon; two bands of white vapor stretched across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon of bingzi, two bands of white vapor stretched across the sky.

sentences.zh: 以去歲水潦霜災，嚴酒禁。

translations.literal: Because of last year's floods, frost, and disasters, the wine prohibition was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: Because of last year's floods, frost, and disasters, the wine prohibition was strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以空名宣敕遣付福建行省，命平章政事曲出、陳有定同驗有功者給之。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, blank-title edicts were sent to the Fujian Branch Secretariat, ordering chief ministers Quchu and Chen Youding jointly to verify meritorious men and grant them.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day blank-title edicts were sent to the Fujian branch secretariat, ordering chief ministers Quchu and Chen Youding jointly to verify meritorious men and grant rewards.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大同隕霜殺麥。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, in Datong falling frost killed the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day in Datong falling frost killed the wheat.

sentences.zh: 癸未，福建行宣政院以廢寺錢糧由海道送京師。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, the Fujian Branch Commission for Buddhist and Secular Affairs sent grain funds from abolished temples to the capital by sea route.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day the Fujian branch commission for Buddhist and secular affairs sent grain funds from abolished temples to the capital by sea.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以完者帖木兒為中書右丞相，辭以老病，不許。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Wanje Temür was appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat; he declined on grounds of age and illness, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Wanje Temür was appointed right chief minister of the Secretariat; he declined on grounds of age and illness, but permission was refused.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以知樞密院事失列門為嶺北行省左丞相，提調分通政院。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Shiremen, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed left chief minister of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat and placed in charge of the Branch Secretariat for Transmission.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao day Shiremen, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was appointed left chief minister of the Lingbei branch secretariat and placed in charge of the branch secretariat for transmission.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以俺普為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Anpu was appointed Secretariat chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Anpu was appointed Secretariat chief minister.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，擴廓帖木兒定擬其所屬官員二千六百一十人，從之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Köke Temür fixed the roster of his subordinate officials at two thousand six hundred ten persons; the proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Köke Temür fixed the roster of his subordinate officials at two thousand six hundred ten persons, and the proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 是月，山東地震，雨白氂。

translations.literal: That month, Shandong was shaken by earthquake and white woolly rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shandong was shaken by earthquake and white woolly rain fell.

sentences.zh: 李思齊遣張良弼部將郭謙等守黃連寨，擴廓帖木兒部將關保、虎林赤、商暠、竹貞引兵拔其寨，郭謙走；

translations.literal: Li Siqi sent Zhang Liangbi's subordinate Guo Qian and others to hold Huanglian Stockade; Köke Temür's subordinates Guan Bao, Qutuγan Qadaγan, Shang Shao, and Zhu Zhen led troops and stormed the stockade; Guo Qian fled;
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi sent Zhang Liangbi's subordinate Guo Qian and others to hold Huanglian Stockade; Köke Temür's subordinates Guan Bao, Qutuγan Qadaγan, Shang Shao, and Zhu Zhen stormed it and Guo Qian fled;

sentences.zh: 會貊高等為變，關保、虎林赤夜遁，李思齊遂解而西。

translations.literal: when Mo Gao and others mutinied, Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan fled by night; Li Siqi thereupon disengaged and marched west.
translations.idiomatic: when Mo Gao and others mutinied, Guan Bao and Qutuγan Qadaγan fled by night, and Li Siqi thereupon disengaged and marched west.

sentences.zh: 月丙午朔，日有食之，晝晦。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingwu new moon; there was an eclipse of the sun and the day turned dim.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of bingwu, there was a solar eclipse and the day turned dim.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，皇太子寢殿後新甃井中有龍出，光焰爍人，宮人震懾仆地。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, in the newly bricked well behind the heir apparent's sleeping hall a dragon emerged, its radiance dazzling people; palace women were shaken and fell prostrate.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day a dragon emerged from the newly bricked well behind the heir apparent's sleeping hall, its radiance dazzling people and palace women so that they fell prostrate in terror.

sentences.zh: 又長慶寺有龍纏繞槐樹飛去，樹皮皆剝。

translations.literal: Again at Changqing Temple a dragon coiled around a locust tree and flew away, stripping all the bark.
translations.idiomatic: Again at Changqing Temple a dragon coiled around a locust tree and flew away, stripping all the bark.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，沂州山崩。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, a mountain in Yizhou collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day a mountain in Yizhou collapsed.

sentences.zh: 是月，知樞密院事壽安，奉空名宣敕與侯伯顏達世，令其以兵援擴廓帖木兒。

translations.literal: That month, Shou'an, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was given blank-title edicts for Hou Boyan Dashi and ordered him to bring troops to aid Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shou'an, director of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was given blank-title edicts for Hou Boyan Dashi and ordered him to bring troops to aid Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 時李思齊據長安，與商暠拒戰，侯伯顏達世進兵攻李思齊，秦州守將蕭公達降思齊。

translations.literal: At that time Li Siqi held Chang'an and fought Shang Shao; Hou Boyan Dashi advanced to attack Li Siqi, and the Qinzhou garrison commander Xiao Gongda surrendered to Siqi.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Li Siqi held Chang'an and fought Shang Shao; Hou Boyan Dashi advanced to attack Li Siqi, and the Qinzhou garrison commander Xiao Gongda surrendered to Siqi.

sentences.zh: 思齊知關保等兵退，遣蔡琳等破其營，侯伯顏達世奔潰。

translations.literal: When Siqi learned that Guan Bao and the others had withdrawn, he sent Cai Lin and others to smash their camp, and Hou Boyan Dashi fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: When Siqi learned that Guan Bao and the others had withdrawn, he sent Cai Lin and others to smash their camp, and Hou Boyan Dashi fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，命也速提調武備寺。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jiashen day; Yesu was ordered to take charge of the Directorate of Armaments.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the jiashen day, Yesu was ordered to take charge of the Directorate of Armaments.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，絳州星隕，光耀如晝。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, stars fell in Jiangzhou, shining bright as day.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day stars fell in Jiangzhou, shining as bright as day.

sentences.zh: 是月，李思齊遣許國佐、薛穆飛會張良弼、脫列伯兵屯於華陰。

translations.literal: That month, Li Siqi sent Xu Guozuo and Xue Mufei to join Zhang Liangbi and Toliber's troops encamped at Huayin.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Siqi sent Xu Guozuo and Xue Mufei to join Zhang Liangbi and Toliber's troops encamped at Huayin.

sentences.zh: 時命禿魯為陜西行省左丞相，思齊不悅，遣其部將鄭應祥守陜西，而自還鳳翔。

translations.literal: At that time Tolu was appointed left chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat; Siqi was displeased, sent his subordinate Zheng Yingxiang to hold Shaanxi, and himself returned to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tolu was appointed left chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat; Siqi was displeased, sent his subordinate Zheng Yingxiang to hold Shaanxi, and himself returned to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 龍見於臨朐龍山，大石起立。

translations.literal: A dragon appeared on Long Mountain in Linqu; a great stone rose upright.
translations.idiomatic: A dragon appeared on Long Mountain in Linqu, and a great stone rose upright.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，詔命皇太子總天下兵馬，其略曰：「元良重任，職在撫軍，稽古征今，卓有成憲。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingwu day; an edict ordered the heir apparent to take overall command of all military forces under Heaven. The gist stated: "The heir's weighty charge lies in comforting the armies; examining antiquity and the present, there are excellent established rules."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the bingwu day, an edict ordered the heir apparent to take overall command of all military forces under Heaven. The gist stated: "The heir's weighty charge lies in comforting the armies; examining antiquity and the present, there are excellent established rules."

sentences.zh: 曩者障塞決河，本以拯民昏墊，豈期妖盜橫造訛言，簧鼓愚頑，塗炭郡邑，殆遍海內，茲逾一紀。

translations.literal: Formerly the Yellow River was blocked to divert its waters, originally to rescue the people from inundation; who could have expected that demonic bandits would spread false reports, drum up the foolish and obstinate, and scourge commanderies and districts until nearly the whole realm was afflicted — now for more than twelve years."
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Yellow River was blocked to divert its waters, originally to rescue the people from inundation; who could have expected demonic bandits to spread false reports, drum up the foolish and obstinate, and scourge commanderies and districts until nearly the whole realm was afflicted for more than twelve years."

sentences.zh: 故察罕帖木兒仗義興師，獻功敵愾，汛掃汴洛，克平青齊，為國捐軀，深可哀悼。

translations.literal: The late Chaghan Temür took up arms in righteousness, presented achievements and hated the enemy, swept Bian and Luo, and conquered Qing and Qi; he gave his life for the state — deeply to be mourned."
translations.idiomatic: The late Chaghan Temür took up arms in righteousness, presented achievements and hated the enemy, swept Bian and Luo, and conquered Qing and Qi; he gave his life for the state, deeply to be mourned."

sentences.zh: 其子擴廓帖木兒克繼先誌，用成駿功。

translations.literal: His son Köke Temür was able to continue his father's purpose and achieve splendid merit."
translations.idiomatic: His son Köke Temür was able to continue his father's purpose and achieve splendid merit."

sentences.zh: 愛猷識理達臘計安宗社，累請出師。

translations.literal: Ayushiridara, calculating how to secure the altars of state, repeatedly requested to take the field."
translations.idiomatic: Ayushiridara, calculating how to secure the altars of state, repeatedly requested to take the field."

sentences.zh: 朕以國本至重，詎宜輕出，遂授擴廓帖木兒總戎重寄，畀以王爵，俾代其行。

translations.literal: I, considering the foundation of the state supremely weighty, could not lightly go forth, and therefore entrusted Köke Temür with the heavy charge of overall command, enfeoffed him with a princely title, and had him go in my stead."
translations.idiomatic: I, considering the foundation of the state supremely weighty, could not lightly go forth, and therefore entrusted Köke Temür with the heavy charge of overall command, enfeoffed him with a princely title, and had him go in my stead."

sentences.zh: 李思齊、張良弼等，各懷異見，構兵不已，以致盜賊愈熾，深遺朕憂。

translations.literal: Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and others each harbored divergent views and raised armies without cease, so that bandits grew ever fiercer — deeply troubling to me."
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and others each harbored divergent views and raised armies without cease, so that bandits grew ever fiercer, deeply troubling to me."

sentences.zh: 況全齊密邇輦轂，儻失早計，恐生異圖，詢諸眾謀，僉謂皇太子聰明仁孝，文武兼資，聿遵舊典，爰命以中書令、樞密使，悉總天下兵馬，諸王、駙馬、各道總兵、將吏，一應軍機政務，生殺予奪，事無輕重，如出朕裁。

translations.literal: Moreover all Qi lies close to the imperial carriage; if early measures are not taken, a different design may arise. Inquiring of the multitude, all said the heir apparent is intelligent, benevolent, and filial, accomplished in both civil and military affairs; following the old statutes, he is therefore appointed Secretariat director and Bureau director to take overall command of all military forces under Heaven. Princes, imperial sons-in-law, commanders of each circuit, and officers — all military affairs, life and death, reward and punishment, whether great or small, shall be as if decided by me."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover all Qi lies close to the imperial carriage; if early measures are not taken, a different design may arise. Inquiring of the multitude, all said the heir apparent is intelligent, benevolent, and filial, accomplished in both civil and military affairs; following the old statutes, he is therefore appointed Secretariat director and Bureau director to take overall command of all military forces under Heaven. Princes, imperial sons-in-law, commanders of each circuit, and officers — all military affairs, life and death, reward and punishment, whether great or small, shall be as if decided by me."

sentences.zh: 其擴廓帖木兒，總領本部軍馬，自潼關以東，肅清江淮；

translations.literal: As for Köke Temür, he shall take overall command of his own forces and, from east of Tong Pass, pacify the Yangtze and Huai regions;"
translations.idiomatic: As for Köke Temür, he shall take overall command of his own forces and, from east of Tong Pass, pacify the Yangtze and Huai regions;"

sentences.zh: 李思齊總統本部軍馬，自鳳翔以西，與侯伯顏達世進取川蜀；

translations.literal: Li Siqi shall take overall command of his own forces and, from west of Fengxiang, advance into Sichuan together with Hou Boyan Dashi;"
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi shall take overall command of his own forces and, from west of Fengxiang, advance into Sichuan together with Hou Boyan Dashi;"

sentences.zh: 以少保禿魯為陜西行中書省左丞相，本省駐劄，總本部及張良弼、孔興、脫列伯各枝軍馬，進取襄樊；

translations.literal: the junior guardian Tolu is appointed left chief minister of the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat; the branch shall be stationed there and take overall command of its own forces together with the branch forces of Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Toliber, and advance on Xiang and Fan;"
translations.idiomatic: the junior guardian Tolu is appointed left chief minister of the Shaanxi branch secretariat; the branch shall be stationed there and take overall command of its own forces together with the branch forces of Zhang Liangbi, Kong Xing, and Toliber, and advance on Xiang and Fan;"

sentences.zh: 王信本部軍馬，固守信地，別聽調遣。

translations.literal: Wang Xin's own forces shall firmly hold their posts and await separate orders."
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xin's own forces shall firmly hold their posts and await separate orders."

sentences.zh: 詔書到日，汝等悉宜洗心滌慮，同濟時艱。

translations.literal: When the edict arrives, you shall all wash your hearts and clear your thoughts and together relieve the present hardship."
translations.idiomatic: When the edict arrives, you shall all wash your hearts and clear your thoughts and together relieve the present hardship."

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，貊高殺衛輝守禦官余仁輔、彰德守禦官範國英，引軍至清化，聞懷慶有備，遂還彰德，上疏言：「人臣以尊君為本，以盡忠為心，以愛民為務。

translations.literal: On gengxu day, Mo Gao killed the Weihui garrison commander Yu Renfu and the Zhangde garrison commander Fan Guoying, led troops to Qinghua, heard that Huaiqing was prepared, and therefore returned to Zhangde. He submitted a memorial stating: "A minister takes honoring the ruler as his foundation, utmost loyalty as his heart, and cherishing the people as his task."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day Mo Gao killed the Weihui garrison commander Yu Renfu and the Zhangde garrison commander Fan Guoying, led troops to Qinghua, heard that Huaiqing was prepared, and therefore returned to Zhangde. He submitted a memorial stating: "A minister takes honoring the ruler as his foundation, utmost loyalty as his heart, and cherishing the people as his task."

sentences.zh: 今總兵官擴廓帖木兒，歲與官軍仇殺，臣等乃朝廷培養之人，素知忠義，焉能俯首聽命。

translations.literal: Now the overall commander Köke Temür year after year fights in mutual slaughter with government troops; we are men whom the court has nurtured and have always known loyalty and righteousness — how can we bow our heads and obey his orders."
translations.idiomatic: Now the overall commander Köke Temür year after year fights in mutual slaughter with government troops; we are men whom the court has nurtured and have always known loyalty and righteousness — how can we bow our heads and obey his orders."

sentences.zh: 乞降明詔，別選重臣，以總大兵。

translations.literal: We beg that a clear edict be issued to select another weighty minister to take overall command of the great armies."
translations.idiomatic: We beg that a clear edict be issued to select another weighty minister to take overall command of the great armies."

sentences.zh: 」詔以擴廓帖木兒不遵君命，宜黜其兵權，就命貊高討之。

translations.literal: An edict stated that Köke Temür did not obey the ruler's command and his military authority should be removed; Mo Gao was ordered to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that Köke Temür did not obey the ruler's command and his military authority should be removed; Mo Gao was ordered to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，帖木兒不花進封淮王，賜金印，設王傅等官。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Temür Buhua was advanced to Prince of Huai, granted a gold seal, and tutors and other offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day Temür Buhua was advanced to Prince of Huai, granted a gold seal, and tutors and other offices were established.

sentences.zh: 壬子，為皇太子立大撫軍院，秩從一品，知院四員，同知二員，副使、同僉各一員，經歷、都事各二員，管勾一員。

translations.literal: On renzi day, the Great Pacification Army Office was established for the heir apparent, of rank second only to the first grade; four directors, two associate directors, one vice commissioner and one joint associate commissioner each, two managers and two clerks each, and one registrar.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the Great Pacification Army Office was established for the heir apparent, of rank second only to the first grade, with four directors, two associate directors, one vice commissioner and one joint associate commissioner each, two managers and two clerks each, and one registrar.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，封太師伯撒裏永平王。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Grand Preceptor Barsari was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Grand Preceptor Barsari was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongping.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以右丞相完者帖木兒、翰林承旨答爾麻、平章政事完者帖木兒並知大撫軍院事。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, right chief minister Wanje Temür, Hanlin academician Darma, and chief minister Wanje Temür were all appointed to manage affairs of the Great Pacification Army Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day right chief minister Wanje Temür, Hanlin academician Darma, and chief minister Wanje Temür were all appointed to manage affairs of the Great Pacification Army Office.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，完者帖木兒言：「大撫軍院專掌軍機，今後迤北軍務，仍舊制樞密院管，其餘內外諸王、駙馬、各處總兵、統兵、行省、行院、宣慰司一應軍情，不許隔越，徑行移大撫軍院。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Wanje Temür said: "The Great Pacification Army Office alone shall handle military affairs; hereafter military affairs in the far north shall still be managed by the Bureau of Military Affairs under the old system; all other military intelligence within and without — princes, imperial sons-in-law, overall commanders, branch commanders, branch secretariats, branch bureaus, and pacification commissions — must not bypass it but shall address the Great Pacification Army Office directly."
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Wanje Temür said: "The Great Pacification Army Office alone shall handle military affairs; hereafter military affairs in the far north shall still be managed by the Bureau of Military Affairs under the old system; all other military intelligence within and without — princes, imperial sons-in-law, overall commanders, branch commanders, branch secretariats, branch bureaus, and pacification commissions — must not bypass it but shall address the Great Pacification Army Office directly."

sentences.zh: 」詹事院同知李國鳳同知大撫軍院事，參政完者帖木兒為副使，左司員外郎咬住、樞密參議王弘遠為經歷。

translations.literal: Joint associate director of the Household of the Heir Apparent Li Guofeng was made joint associate director of the Great Pacification Army Office; associate chief minister Wanje Temür was made vice commissioner; left secretariat section outer official Bayaqut and Bureau deliberator Wang Hongyuan were made managers.
translations.idiomatic: Joint associate director of the heir apparent's household Li Guofeng was made joint associate director of the Great Pacification Army Office; associate chief minister Wanje Temür was made vice commissioner; left secretariat section outer official Bayaqut and Bureau deliberator Wang Hongyuan were made managers.

sentences.zh: 庚申，完者帖木兒言：「諸軍將士有能用命效力建立奇功者，請所賞宣敕依常制外，加以忠義功臣之號。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Wanje Temür said: "For army officers and soldiers who obey orders, exert themselves, and establish extraordinary merit, besides the usual reward edicts please add the title of Loyal and Righteous Meritorious Subject."
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Wanje Temür said: "For army officers and soldiers who obey orders, exert themselves, and establish extraordinary merit, besides the usual reward edicts please add the title of Loyal and Righteous Meritorious Subject."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以完者帖木兒仍前少師、知樞密院事，也速仍前太保、中書右丞相，帖裏帖木兒以太尉、添設中書左丞相。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, Wanje Temür retained his former posts as junior mentor and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yesu retained his former posts as grand guardian and right chief minister of the Secretariat; Tegri Temür was made grand preceptor and additional left chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day Wanje Temür retained his former posts as junior mentor and director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Yesu retained his former posts as grand guardian and right chief minister of the Secretariat; Tegri Temür was made grand preceptor and additional left chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，立行樞密院於阿難答察罕腦兒，命陜西行省左丞相禿魯仍前少保兼知行樞密院事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, a branch Bureau of Military Affairs was established at Anandaqaghan Na'ur; Shaanxi left chief minister Tolu retained his former post as junior guardian and was made concurrent director of the branch bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day a branch Bureau of Military Affairs was established at Anandaqaghan Na'ur; Shaanxi left chief minister Tolu retained his former post as junior guardian and was made concurrent director of the branch bureau.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命帖裏帖木兒仍前太尉、左丞相，為知大撫軍院事；

translations.literal: On renshen day, Tegri Temür retained his former posts as grand preceptor and left chief minister and was made to manage affairs of the Great Pacification Army Office;
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen day Tegri Temür retained his former posts as grand preceptor and left chief minister and was made to manage affairs of the Great Pacification Army Office;

sentences.zh: 中書右丞陳敬伯為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: right vice chief minister Chen Jingbo was appointed Secretariat chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: right vice chief minister Chen Jingbo was appointed Secretariat chief minister.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌朔，義士戴晉生上皇太子書，言治亂之由。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiaxu new moon; the worthy man Dai Jinsheng presented a book to the heir apparent on the causes of order and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon of jiaxu, the worthy man Dai Jinsheng presented a book to the heir apparent on the causes of order and disorder.

sentences.zh: 命右丞相也速以兵往山東，命參知政事法都忽剌分戶部官，一同供給。

translations.literal: The right chief minister Yesu was ordered to take troops to Shandong; associate chief minister Fadu Hula was ordered to divide revenue officials of the Ministry of Revenue to supply them together.
translations.idiomatic: The right chief minister Yesu was ordered to take troops to Shandong; associate chief minister Fadu Hula was ordered to divide revenue officials of the Ministry of Revenue to supply them together.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以兵興，迤南百姓供給繁重，其真定、河南、陜西、山東、冀寧等處，除軍人自耕自食外，與免民間今年田租之半，其餘雜泛一切住罷。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, because warfare had arisen, the southern people's burdens were heavy; in Zhending, Henan, Shaanxi, Shandong, Jining, and other places, apart from soldiers farming and feeding themselves, half of this year's field tax was remitted to the populace, and all other miscellaneous levies were entirely suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day, because warfare had arisen, the southern people's burdens were heavy; in Zhending, Henan, Shaanxi, Shandong, Jining, and other places, apart from soldiers farming and feeding themselves, half of this year's field tax was remitted to the populace, and all other miscellaneous levies were entirely suspended.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，大明兵取平江路，執張士誠。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, Ming forces took Pingjiang Circuit and captured Zhang Shicheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day Ming forces captured Pingjiang Circuit and took Zhang Shicheng prisoner.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，大明兵取通州。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, Ming forces took Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Ming forces captured Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大明兵取無錫州。

translations.literal: On dinghai day, Ming forces took Wuxi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day Ming forces captured Wuxi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔也速以中書右丞相分省山東，沙藍答裏以中書左丞相分省大同。

translations.literal: On jichou day, an edict ordered Yesu, as right chief minister of the Secretariat, to establish a branch secretariat in Shandong, and Shalandari, as left chief minister, to establish a branch secretariat in Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jichou day an edict ordered Yesu, as right chief minister of the Secretariat, to establish a branch secretariat in Shandong, and Shalandari, as left chief minister, to establish a branch secretariat in Datong.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太師汪家奴追封兗王，謚忠靖。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Grand Preceptor Wangjianu was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yan with the posthumous title Zhongjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Grand Preceptor Wangjianu was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Yan with the posthumous title Zhongjing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命帖裏帖木兒提調端本堂及領經筵事。

translations.literal: On jihai day, Tegri Temür was ordered to take charge of the Hall of the Correct Origin and to lead the Classics Lectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Tegri Temür was ordered to take charge of the Hall of the Correct Origin and to lead the Classics Lectures.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大明兵取臺州路。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Ming forces took Taizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Ming forces captured Taizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時臺州、溫州、慶元三路皆方國珍所據。

translations.literal: At that time Taizhou, Wenzhou, and Qingyuan circuits were all held by Fang Guozhen.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Taizhou, Wenzhou, and Qingyuan circuits were all held by Fang Guozhen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰朔，貊高以兵入山西，定孟州、忻州，下漷州，遂攻真定。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, jiachen new moon; Mo Gao entered Shanxi with troops, secured Mengzhou and Xinzhou, took Huazhou, and then attacked Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon of jiachen, Mo Gao entered Shanxi with troops, secured Mengzhou and Xinzhou, took Huazhou, and then attacked Zhending.

sentences.zh: 詔也速自河間以兵會貊高取真定，已而不克，命也速還河間，貊高還彰德。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Yesu to lead troops from Hejian to join Mo Gao in taking Zhending; they did not succeed; Yesu was ordered back to Hejian and Mo Gao back to Zhangde.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yesu to lead troops from Hejian to join Mo Gao in taking Zhending; they did not succeed; Yesu was ordered back to Hejian and Mo Gao back to Zhangde.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇太子奏以淮南行省平章政事王信為山東行省平章政事兼知行樞密院事。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the heir apparent memorialized that Wang Xin, chief minister of the Huainan Branch Secretariat, be made chief minister of the Shandong Branch Secretariat with concurrent charge of the branch bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day the heir apparent memorialized that Wang Xin, chief minister of the Huainan branch secretariat, be made chief minister of the Shandong branch secretariat with concurrent charge of the branch bureau.

sentences.zh: 立中書分省於真定路。

translations.literal: A branch Secretariat was established at Zhending Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: A branch Secretariat was established at Zhending Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙午，加司徒、淮南行省平章政事王宣為沂國公。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Minister of Works and Huainan chief minister Wang Xuan was advanced to Duke of Yi.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Minister of Works and Huainan chief minister Wang Xuan was advanced to Duke of Yi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, an offering was made in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day an offering was made in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔擴廓帖木兒落太傅、中書左丞相並諸兼領職事，仍前河南王，錫以汝州為其食邑；

translations.literal: On renzi day, an edict removed Köke Temür from the posts of grand preceptor, left chief minister of the Secretariat, and all concurrent offices; he retained his former title as Prince of Henan, and Ruzhou was granted as his fief;
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day an edict removed Köke Temür from the posts of grand preceptor, left chief minister of the Secretariat, and all concurrent offices; he retained his former title as Prince of Henan, and Ruzhou was granted as his fief;

sentences.zh: 其弟脫因帖木兒以集賢學士同擴廓帖木兒於河南府居。

translations.literal: his younger brother Toyin Temür, as academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, was to dwell with Köke Temür at Henan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: his younger brother Toyin Temür, as academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, was to dwell with Köke Temür at Henan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 其帳前諸軍，命瑣住、虎林赤一同統之。

translations.literal: The troops before his tent were ordered to be jointly commanded by Suoju and Qutuγan Qadaγan.
translations.idiomatic: The troops before his tent were ordered to be jointly commanded by Suoju and Qutuγan Qadaγan.

sentences.zh: 其河南諸軍，命中書平章政事、內史李克彜統之。

translations.literal: The Henan troops were ordered to be commanded by chief minister and palace secretary Li Keyi.
translations.idiomatic: The Henan troops were ordered to be commanded by chief minister and palace secretary Li Keyi.

sentences.zh: 關保本部諸軍仍舊統之。

translations.literal: Guan Bao's own troops were to be commanded as before.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bao's own troops were to be commanded as before.

sentences.zh: 山東諸軍，命太保、中書右丞相也速統之。

translations.literal: The Shandong troops were ordered to be commanded by Grand Guardian and right chief minister Yesu.
translations.idiomatic: The Shandong troops were ordered to be commanded by grand guardian and right chief minister Yesu.

sentences.zh: 山西諸軍，命少保、中書左丞相沙藍答裏統之。

translations.literal: The Shanxi troops were ordered to be commanded by Junior Guardian and left chief minister Shalandari.
translations.idiomatic: The Shanxi troops were ordered to be commanded by junior guardian and left chief minister Shalandari.

sentences.zh: 河北諸軍，命知樞密院事貊高統之。

translations.literal: The Hebei troops were ordered to be commanded by Bureau director Mo Gao.
translations.idiomatic: The Hebei troops were ordered to be commanded by Bureau director Mo Gao.

sentences.zh: 赦天下。

translations.literal: An amnesty was proclaimed to all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed to all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以火裏赤為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Qoγai was appointed Secretariat chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Qoγai was appointed Secretariat chief minister.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命集賢大學士丁好禮為中書添設平章政事。

translations.literal: On yichou day, Grand Academician Ding Haoli was appointed additional Secretariat chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day Grand Academician Ding Haoli was appointed additional Secretariat chief minister.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，平章、內史關保封許國公。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, chief minister and palace secretary Guan Bao was enfeoffed as Duke of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day chief minister and palace secretary Guan Bao was enfeoffed as Duke of Xu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大明兵取溫州。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Ming forces took Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day Ming forces captured Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，大明兵取沂州，守臣王信遁，其父宣被執。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renwu day; Ming forces took Yizhou; the defending official Wang Xin fled and his father Xuan was captured.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on the renwu day, Ming forces captured Yizhou; the defending official Wang Xin fled and his father Xuan was captured.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大明兵取慶元路。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Ming forces took Qingyuan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day Ming forces captured Qingyuan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以平章政事月魯帖木兒，知樞密院事完者帖木兒，平章政事伯顏帖木兒、帖林沙並知撫軍院事。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, chief minister Yelu Temür, Bureau director Wanje Temür, and chief ministers Bayan Temür and Telin Sha were all appointed to manage affairs of the Pacification Army Office.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day chief minister Yelu Temür, Bureau director Wanje Temür, and chief ministers Bayan Temür and Telin Sha were all appointed to manage affairs of the Pacification Army Office.

sentences.zh: 戊子，大明兵取嶧州。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Ming forces took Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day Ming forces captured Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以知樞密院事貊高為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, Bureau director Mo Gao was appointed Secretariat chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Bureau director Mo Gao was appointed Secretariat chief minister.

sentences.zh: 命太尉、中書左丞相帖裏帖木兒為撫軍院使。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor and left chief minister Tegri Temür was appointed commissioner of the Pacification Army Office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor and left chief minister Tegri Temür was appointed commissioner of the Pacification Army Office.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命帖裏帖木兒同監修國史。

translations.literal: On dingyou day, Tegri Temür was ordered jointly to supervise compilation of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Tegri Temür was ordered jointly to supervise compilation of the national history.

sentences.zh: 命關保分省於晉寧。

translations.literal: Guan Bao was ordered to establish a branch secretariat at Jinning.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bao was ordered to establish a branch secretariat at Jinning.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大明兵取益都路，平章政事保保降，宣慰使普顏不花、總管胡濬、知院張俊皆死之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Ming forces took Yidu Circuit; chief minister Baobao surrendered; Pacification Commissioner Puyan Buhua, prefect Hu Jun, and director Zhang Jun all died.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Ming forces captured Yidu Circuit; chief minister Baobao surrendered; pacification commissioner Puyan Buhua, prefect Hu Jun, and director Zhang Jun all died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guimao new moon; there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the new moon of guimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大明兵取般陽路。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Ming forces took Banyang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Ming forces captured Banyang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大明兵取濟寧路，陳秉直遁。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Ming forces took Jining Circuit; Chen Bingzhi fled.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Ming forces captured Jining Circuit; Chen Bingzhi fled.

sentences.zh: 己酉，大明兵取萊州，遂取濟南及東平路。

translations.literal: On jiyou day, Ming forces took Laizhou and then took Jinan and Dongping circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Ming forces captured Laizhou and then took Jinan and Dongping circuits.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大明兵入杉關，取邵武路。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, Ming forces entered Shan Pass and took Shaowu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Ming forces entered Shan Pass and captured Shaowu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時邵武、建寧、延平、福州、興化、泉、漳、汀、潮諸路，皆陳友定所據。

translations.literal: At that time Shaowu, Jianning, Yanping, Fuzhou, Xinghua, Quan, Zhang, Ting, and Chao circuits were all held by Chen Youding.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Shaowu, Jianning, Yanping, Fuzhou, Xinghua, Quan, Zhang, Ting, and Chao circuits were all held by Chen Youding.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以楊誠、陳秉直並為國公、中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Yang Cheng and Chen Bingzhi were both enfeoffed as state dukes and appointed Secretariat chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day Yang Cheng and Chen Bingzhi were both enfeoffed as state dukes and appointed Secretariat chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命右丞相也速，太尉知院脫火赤，中書平章政事忽林臺，平章政事貊高，知樞密院事小章、典堅帖木兒、江文清、驢兒等會楊誠、陳秉直、伯顏不花、俞勝各部諸軍同守禦山東，又命關保往援山東。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, the right chief minister Yesu, Grand Preceptor and Bureau director Toγači, chief minister Qolin Tai, chief minister Mo Gao, Bureau directors Xiao Zhang, Tegün Temür, Jiang Wenqing, Lü'er, and others were ordered to join Yang Cheng, Chen Bingzhi, Bayan Buhua, Yu Sheng, and the troops of each division in jointly defending Shandong; Guan Bao was also ordered to go to aid Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day the right chief minister Yesu, grand preceptor and Bureau director Toγači, chief minister Qolin Tai, chief minister Mo Gao, Bureau directors Xiao Zhang, Tegün Temür, Jiang Wenqing, Lü'er, and others were ordered to join Yang Cheng, Chen Bingzhi, Bayan Buhua, Yu Sheng, and the troops of each division in jointly defending Shandong; Guan Bao was also ordered to go to aid Shandong.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以莊家為中書參知政事。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Zhuang Jia was appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Zhuang Jia was appointed associate chief minister of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚午，大明兵由海道取福州，守臣平章政事曲出遁，行宣政院使朵耳死之。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, Ming forces took Fuzhou by sea; the defending chief minister Quchu fled; Branch Commission for Buddhist and Secular Affairs commissioner Duo'er died.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Ming forces took Fuzhou by sea; the defending chief minister Quchu fled; branch commission commissioner Duo'er died.

sentences.zh: 是月，方國珍歸於大明。

translations.literal: That month, Fang Guozhen submitted to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fang Guozhen submitted to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 詔命陜西行省左丞相禿魯總統張良弼、脫列伯、孔興各枝軍馬，以李思齊為副總統，禦關中，撫安軍民。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Shaanxi left chief minister Tolu to take overall command of the branch forces of Zhang Liangbi, Toliber, and Kong Xing, with Li Siqi as deputy overall commander, to defend Guanzhong and reassure troops and people.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Shaanxi left chief minister Tolu to take overall command of the branch forces of Zhang Liangbi, Toliber, and Kong Xing, with Li Siqi as deputy overall commander, to defend Guanzhong and reassure troops and people.

sentences.zh: 脫列伯、孔興等出潼關，及取順便山路，渡黃河合勢東行，共勤王事。

translations.literal: Toliber, Kong Xing, and others were to go out through Tong Pass and, taking convenient mountain routes, cross the Yellow River and advance east in combined force to perform the king's service together.
translations.idiomatic: Toliber, Kong Xing, and others were to go out through Tong Pass and, taking convenient mountain routes, cross the Yellow River and advance east in combined force to perform the king's service together.

sentences.zh: 思齊等皆不奉命。

translations.literal: Siqi and the others all refused the command.
translations.idiomatic: Siqi and the others all refused the command.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔分潼關以西屬李思齊，以東屬擴廓帖木兒，各罷兵還鎮。

translations.literal: That year, an edict divided the region west of Tong Pass to Li Siqi and east of Tong Pass to Köke Temür; each was to cease warfare and return to his post.
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict divided the region west of Tong Pass to Li Siqi and east of Tong Pass to Köke Temür; each was to cease warfare and return to his post.

sentences.zh: 於是關保退屯潞州，商暠留屯潼關。

translations.literal: Thereupon Guan Bao withdrew to garrison at Luzhou and Shang Shao remained garrisoned at Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Guan Bao withdrew to garrison at Luzhou and Shang Shao remained garrisoned at Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月壬申朔，皇太子命關保固守晉寧，總統諸軍，如擴廓帖木兒拒命，當以大義相裁，就便擒擊。

translations.literal: Twenty-eighth year, spring, first month, renshen new moon; the heir apparent ordered Guan Bao to hold Jinning firmly and take overall command of all armies; if Köke Temür resisted orders, he should be restrained by righteous principle and captured or struck as convenient.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, on the new moon of renshen in the first month of spring, the heir apparent ordered Guan Bao to hold Jinning firmly and take overall command of all armies; if Köke Temür resisted orders, he should be restrained by righteous principle and captured or struck as convenient.

sentences.zh: 以中書平章政事不顏帖木兒為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Chief minister Buyan Temür was appointed censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Chief minister Buyan Temür was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔諭擴廓帖木兒曰：「比者也速上奏，卿以書陳情，深自悔悟，及省來意，良用惻然。

translations.literal: On xinsi day, an edict instructed Köke Temür: "Recently Yesu memorialized above and you stated your feelings in a letter, deeply repenting — when I examined your intent I was greatly moved with compassion."
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day an edict instructed Köke Temür: "Recently Yesu memorialized above and you stated your feelings in a letter, deeply repenting — when I examined your intent I was greatly moved with compassion."

sentences.zh: 朕視卿猶子，卿何惑於憸言，不體朕心，隳其先業！

translations.literal: I regard you as a son — why are you deluded by slanderous words, failing to understand my heart and destroying your father's achievement!"
translations.idiomatic: I regard you as a son — why are you deluded by slanderous words, failing to understand my heart and destroying your father's achievement!"

sentences.zh: 卿今能自悔，固朕所望。

translations.literal: That you can now repent is indeed what I hope for."
translations.idiomatic: That you can now repent is indeed what I hope for."

sentences.zh: 卿其思昔委任肅清江淮之意，即將冀寧、真定諸軍，就行統制渡河，直搗徐沂，以康靖齊魯，則職任之隆，當悉還汝。

translations.literal: Consider the purpose for which you were formerly entrusted to pacify the Yangtze and Huai; immediately take the armies of Jining and Zhending, assume command on the march, cross the river, strike straight at Xu and Yi, and restore peace to Qi and Lu — then your lofty offices shall all be returned to you."
translations.idiomatic: Consider the purpose for which you were formerly entrusted to pacify the Yangtze and Huai; immediately take the armies of Jining and Zhending, assume command on the march, cross the river, strike straight at Xu and Yi, and restore peace to Qi and Lu — then your lofty offices shall all be returned to you."

sentences.zh: 衛輝、彰德、順德，皆為王城，卿無以貊高為名，縱軍侵暴。

translations.literal: Weihui, Zhangde, and Shunde are all princely domains — do not, in Mo Gao's name, let your troops invade and ravage them."
translations.idiomatic: Weihui, Zhangde, and Shunde are all princely domains — do not, in Mo Gao's name, let your troops invade and ravage them."

sentences.zh: 其晉寧諸軍，已命關保總制策應，戡定山東，將帥各宜悉心。

translations.literal: The Jinning armies have already been ordered to be placed under Guan Bao's overall command for coordinated response and to pacify Shandong; commanders and generals should each devote their full effort."
translations.idiomatic: The Jinning armies have already been ordered to be placed under Guan Bao's overall command for coordinated response and to pacify Shandong; commanders and generals should each devote their full effort."

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，彗星見於昴、畢之間。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, a comet appeared between the Mao and Bi mansions.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day a comet appeared between the Mao and Bi mansions.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取建寧、延平二路，陳有定被執。

translations.literal: That month, Ming forces took Jianning and Yanping circuits; Chen Youding was captured.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces captured Jianning and Yanping circuits; Chen Youding was captured.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅朔，詔削擴廓帖木兒爵邑，命禿魯、李思齊等討之，詔曰：「擴廓帖木兒本非察罕帖木兒之宗，俾嗣職任，冀承遺烈，畀以相位，陟以師垣，崇以王爵，授以兵柄，顧乃憑藉寵靈，遂肆跋扈，構兵關陜，專事吞並。

translations.literal: Second month, renyin new moon; an edict stripped Köke Temür of his fief and title and ordered Tolu, Li Siqi, and others to campaign against him. The edict stated: "Köke Temür was not of Chaghan Temür's lineage; he was made to succeed the post in hope he would carry on the legacy, was given the chief ministry, raised to the military command, ennobled with a princely title, and entrusted with the command of troops — yet he relied on favor and then acted insolently, raised armies in Guan and Shaanxi, and devoted himself to annexation."
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon of renyin, an edict stripped Köke Temür of his fief and title and ordered Tolu, Li Siqi, and others to campaign against him. The edict stated: "Köke Temür was not of Chaghan Temür's lineage; he was made to succeed the post in hope he would carry on the legacy, was given the chief ministry, raised to the military command, ennobled with a princely title, and entrusted with the command of troops — yet he relied on favor and then acted insolently, raised armies in Guan and Shaanxi, and devoted himself to annexation."

sentences.zh: 貊高倡明大義，首發奸謀，關保弗信邪言，乃心王室，陳其罪惡，請正邦典。

translations.literal: Mo Gao proclaimed the great principle and was first to expose the treacherous plot; Guan Bao did not believe evil words and kept his heart with the royal house; they set forth his crimes and asked that the state's law be applied."
translations.idiomatic: Mo Gao proclaimed the great principle and was first to expose the treacherous plot; Guan Bao did not believe evil words and kept his heart with the royal house; they set forth his crimes and asked that the state's law be applied."

sentences.zh: 今禿魯、李思齊，其率兵東下，共行天討。

translations.literal: Now Tolu and Li Siqi shall lead troops east and together execute Heaven's punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Now Tolu and Li Siqi shall lead troops east and together execute Heaven's punishment."

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，武庫災。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the armory suffered fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day the armory suffered fire.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大明兵取東昌路，守將申榮、王輔元死之。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Ming forces took Dongchang Circuit; the defending generals Shen Rong and Wang Fuyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Ming forces captured Dongchang Circuit; the defending generals Shen Rong and Wang Fuyuan died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，擴廓帖木兒自澤州退守晉寧，關保守澤、潞二州，與貊高軍合。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, Köke Temür withdrew from Zezhou to hold Jinning; Guan Bao held Ze and Lu prefectures and joined with Mo Gao's army.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day Köke Temür withdrew from Zezhou to hold Jinning; Guan Bao held Ze and Lu prefectures and joined with Mo Gao's army.

sentences.zh: 己未，大明兵取寶慶路。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Ming forces took Baoqing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Ming forces captured Baoqing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲子，汀州路總管陳谷珍以城降於大明。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Tingzhou Circuit prefect Chen Guzhen surrendered the city to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Tingzhou Circuit prefect Chen Guzhen surrendered the city to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，大明兵取棣州。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Ming forces took Dizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day Ming forces captured Dizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵至河南，李思齊、張良弼等解兵西還。

translations.literal: That month, Ming forces reached Henan; Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and others disbanded their armies and marched back west.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces reached Henan; Li Siqi, Zhang Liangbi, and others disbanded their armies and marched back west.

sentences.zh: 詔命知樞密院事脫火赤、平章政事魏賽因不花進兵攻晉寧。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Bureau director Toγači and chief minister Esyin Buhua to advance troops and attack Jinning.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Bureau director Toγači and chief minister Esyin Buhua to advance troops and attack Jinning.

sentences.zh: 李思齊次渭南，張良弼次櫟陽。

translations.literal: Li Siqi encamped at Weinan; Zhang Liangbi encamped at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi encamped at Weinan; Zhang Liangbi encamped at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 興化、泉州、漳州、潮州四路皆降於大明。

translations.literal: Xinghua, Quan, Zhang, and Chao circuits all surrendered to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Xinghua, Quan, Zhang, and Chao circuits all surrendered to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，彗星見於西北。

translations.literal: Third month, gengyin day; a comet appeared in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the gengyin day, a comet appeared in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，翰林學士承旨王時、太常院使陳祖仁上章，乞撫諭擴廓帖木兒，以兵勤王赴難。

translations.literal: On renchen day, Hanlin academician Cheng Wang and Director of Imperial Sacrifices Chen Zuren submitted memorials begging that Köke Temür be reassured and that he bring troops as king's aid in the emergency.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day Hanlin academician Cheng Wang and director of imperial sacrifices Chen Zuren submitted memorials begging that Köke Temür be reassured and that he bring troops as king's aid in the emergency.

sentences.zh: 是月，有星流於東北，眾小星隨之，其聲大震。

translations.literal: That month, a star flew in the northeast and many small stars followed; the sound shook greatly.
translations.idiomatic: That month a star flew in the northeast and many small stars followed; the sound shook greatly.

sentences.zh: 大明兵取河南。

translations.literal: Ming forces took Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces captured Henan.

sentences.zh: 李思齊、張良弼會兵駐潼關，火焚良弼營，思齊移軍葫蘆灘，調其所部張德斂、穆薛飛守潼關。

translations.literal: Li Siqi and Zhang Liangbi joined forces garrisoned at Tong Pass; fire burned Liangbi's camp; Siqi moved his army to Hulu Beach and deployed his subordinates Zhang Deyi and Mu Xuefei to hold Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siqi and Zhang Liangbi joined forces garrisoned at Tong Pass; fire burned Liangbi's camp; Siqi moved his army to Hulu Beach and deployed his subordinates Zhang Deyi and Mu Xuefei to hold Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 大明兵入潼關，攻李思齊營，思齊棄輜重，奔於鳳翔。

translations.literal: Ming forces entered Tong Pass and attacked Li Siqi's camp; Siqi abandoned his baggage train and fled to Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces entered Tong Pass and attacked Li Siqi's camp; Siqi abandoned his baggage train and fled to Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 是月，大明兵取永州路，又取惠州路。

translations.literal: That month, Ming forces took Yongzhou Circuit and also took Huizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: That month Ming forces captured Yongzhou Circuit and also captured Huizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑朔，大明兵取英德州。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinchou new moon; Ming forces took Yingde Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the new moon of xinchou, Ming forces captured Yingde Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙午，隕霜殺菽。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, falling frost killed beans.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day falling frost killed beans.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大明兵取廣州路，又取嵩、陜、汝等州。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Ming forces took Guangzhou Circuit and also took Song, Shaan, and Ru prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Ming forces captured Guangzhou Circuit and also took Song, Shaan, and Ru prefectures.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午朔，大明兵取道州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengwu new moon; Ming forces took Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon of gengwu, Ming forces captured Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 李克彜棄河南城，奔陜西，推李思齊為總兵，駐兵岐山。

translations.literal: Li Keyi abandoned Henan city and fled to Shaanxi, acclaiming Li Siqi as overall commander and stationing troops at Qishan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Keyi abandoned Henan city and fled to Shaanxi, acclaiming Li Siqi as overall commander and stationing troops at Qishan.

sentences.zh: 是月，李思齊部將忽林赤、脫脫、張意據盩啡，高暠據武功，李克彜據岐山，任從政據隴州。

translations.literal: That month, Li Siqi's subordinates Qolin Či, Totoγan, and Zhang Yi held Zhouzhi; Gao Shao held Wugong; Li Keyi held Qishan; Ren Congzheng held Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Siqi's subordinates Qolin Či, Totoγan, and Zhang Yi held Zhouzhi; Gao Shao held Wugong; Li Keyi held Qishan; and Ren Congzheng held Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子朔，徐溝縣地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengzi new moon; Xugou County was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the new moon of gengzi, Xugou County was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大明兵取全州、郴州、梧州、藤州、潯州、貴、象、郁林等郡。

translations.literal: On guichou day, Ming forces took Quan, Chen, Wuzhou, Teng, Xun, Gui, Xiang, and Yulin prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Ming forces captured Quan, Chen, Wuzhou, Teng, Xun, Gui, Xiang, and Yulin prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，雷雨中有火自天墜，焚大聖壽萬安寺。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, amid thunder and rain fire fell from the sky and burned the Temple of Great Sagely Longevity and Ten Thousand Peace.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day, amid thunder and rain, fire fell from the sky and burned the Temple of Great Sagely Longevity and Ten Thousand Peace.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，臨州、保德州地震，五日不止。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Linzhou and Baode Prefecture were shaken by earthquake for five days without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day Linzhou and Baode Prefecture were shaken by earthquake for five days without stopping.

sentences.zh: 大明兵取靜江路。

translations.literal: Ming forces took Jingjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces captured Jingjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 是月，廣西諸郡縣皆附於大明。

translations.literal: That month, all prefectures and counties in Guangxi submitted to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: That month all prefectures and counties in Guangxi submitted to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，京城紅氣滿空，如火照人，自旦至辰方息。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guiyou day; red vapor filled the capital sky, shining on people like fire from dawn until the chen hour before it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the guiyou day, red vapor filled the capital sky, shining on people like fire from dawn until the chen hour before it ceased.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，京城黑氣起，百步內不見人，從寅至巳方消。

translations.literal: On yihai day, black vapor rose in the capital; within a hundred paces people could not be seen; it dissipated from yin to si.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day black vapor rose in the capital; within a hundred paces people could not be seen; it dissipated from yin to si.

sentences.zh: 貊高、關保以兵攻晉寧。

translations.literal: Mo Gao and Guan Bao attacked Jinning with troops.
translations.idiomatic: Mo Gao and Guan Bao attacked Jinning with troops.

sentences.zh: 是月，李思齊會李克彜、商暠、張意、脫列伯等於鳳翔。

translations.literal: That month, Li Siqi joined Li Keyi, Shang Shao, Zhang Yi, Toliber, and others at Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Li Siqi joined Li Keyi, Shang Shao, Zhang Yi, Toliber, and others at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 海南、海北諸郡縣皆降於大明。

translations.literal: All prefectures and counties in Hainan and Haibei submitted to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: All prefectures and counties in Hainan and Haibei submitted to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 閏月己亥朔，擴廓帖木兒與貊高、關保戰，敗之，擒關保、貊高，遣其斷事官以聞。

translations.literal: Intercalary seventh month, jihai new moon; Köke Temür fought Mo Gao and Guan Bao and defeated them, capturing Guan Bao and Mo Gao, and sent his judicial officer to report.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary seventh month, on the new moon of jihai, Köke Temür fought Mo Gao and Guan Bao and defeated them, capturing Guan Bao and Mo Gao, and sent his judicial officer to report.

sentences.zh: 詔：「關保、貊高，間諜構兵，可依軍法處治。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Guan Bao and Mo Gao, as spies, raised armies in discord — they may be dealt with according to military law."
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Guan Bao and Mo Gao, as spies, raised armies in discord — they may be dealt with according to military law."

sentences.zh: 」關保、貊高皆被殺。

translations.literal: Guan Bao and Mo Gao were both executed.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Bao and Mo Gao were both executed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，大明兵取衛輝路。

translations.literal: On xinchou day, Ming forces took Weihui Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Ming forces captured Weihui Circuit.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大明兵取彰德路。

translations.literal: On guimao day, Ming forces took Zhangde Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day Ming forces captured Zhangde Circuit.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，左江、右江諸路皆降於大明。

translations.literal: On yisi day, the left and right Jiang circuits all submitted to the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day the left and right Jiang circuits all submitted to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大明兵取廣平路。

translations.literal: On dingwei day, Ming forces took Guangping Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day Ming forces captured Guangping Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔罷大撫軍院，誅知大撫軍院事伯顏帖木兒等。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict abolished the Great Pacification Army Office and executed Bayan Temür and others who managed its affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day an edict abolished the Great Pacification Army Office and executed Bayan Temür and others who managed its affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔復命擴廓帖木兒仍前河南王、太傅、中書左丞相，統領見部軍馬，由中道直抵彰德、衛輝；

translations.literal: An edict again appointed Köke Temür to his former posts as Prince of Henan, grand preceptor, and left chief minister of the Secretariat, to take overall command of his present forces and, by the central route, advance straight to Zhangde and Weihui;
translations.idiomatic: An edict again appointed Köke Temür to his former posts as Prince of Henan, grand preceptor, and left chief minister of the Secretariat, to take overall command of his present forces and, by the central route, advance straight to Zhangde and Weihui;

sentences.zh: 太保、中書右丞相也速統率大軍，經由東道，水陸並進；

translations.literal: Grand Guardian and right chief minister Yesu was to lead the great army by the eastern route, advancing by land and water together;
translations.idiomatic: Grand guardian and right chief minister Yesu was to lead the great army by the eastern route, advancing by land and water together;

sentences.zh: 少保、陜西行省左丞相禿魯統率關陜諸軍，東出潼關，攻取河洛；

translations.literal: Junior Guardian and Shaanxi left chief minister Tolu was to lead the Guan and Shaanxi armies, marching east out of Tong Pass to attack and take Heluo;
translations.idiomatic: Junior guardian and Shaanxi left chief minister Tolu was to lead the Guan and Shaanxi armies, marching east out of Tong Pass to attack and take Heluo;

sentences.zh: 太尉、平章政事李思齊統率軍馬，南出七盤、金、商，克復汴洛。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor and chief minister Li Siqi was to lead his army south out of Qipan, Jin, and Shang to recover Bian and Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor and chief minister Li Siqi was to lead his army south out of Qipan, Jin, and Shang to recover Bian and Luo.

sentences.zh: 四道進兵，掎角剿捕，毋分彼此。

translations.literal: The four routes were to advance in concert, supporting one another in pursuit and suppression, without distinguishing priority.
translations.idiomatic: The four routes were to advance in concert, supporting one another in pursuit and suppression, without distinguishing priority.
