sentences.zh: 秦國公、平章、知院俺普，平章瑣住等軍，東西布列，乘機掃殄。

translations.literal: State Duke and chief minister Anpu, chief minister Suoju, and other armies were to be deployed east and west, seizing opportunities to sweep away the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: State duke and chief minister Anpu, chief minister Suoju, and other armies were to be deployed east and west, seizing opportunities to sweep away the enemy.

sentences.zh: 太尉、遼陽左丞相也先不花，郡王、知院厚孫等軍，捍禦海口，藩屏畿輔。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor and Liaoyang left chief minister Yexian Buhua, prince and Bureau director Husun, and other armies were to defend the sea mouth and shield the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor and Liaoyang left chief minister Yexian Buhua, prince and Bureau director Husun, and other armies were to defend the sea mouth and shield the capital region.

sentences.zh: 皇太子愛猷識理達臘悉總天下兵馬，裁決庶務，具如前詔。

translations.literal: The heir apparent Ayushiridara was to take overall command of all military forces under Heaven and decide all affairs, as in the former edict.
translations.idiomatic: The heir apparent Ayushiridara was to take overall command of all military forces under Heaven and decide all affairs, as in the former edict.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On renxu day, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，罷內府河役。

translations.literal: On guihai day, corvée on the inner palace river works was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai day corvée on the inner palace river works was suspended.

sentences.zh: 甲子，擴廓帖木兒自晉寧退守冀寧。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, Köke Temür withdrew from Jinning to hold Jining.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day Köke Temür withdrew from Jinning to hold Jining.

sentences.zh: 大明兵至通州。

translations.literal: Ming forces reached Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ming forces reached Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 知樞密院事卜顏帖木兒力戰，被擒死之。

translations.literal: Bureau director Buyan Temür fought fiercely and was captured and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau director Buyan Temür fought fiercely and was captured and killed.

sentences.zh: 左丞相失列門傳旨，令太常禮儀院使阿魯渾等，奉太廟列室神主與皇太子同北行。

translations.literal: Left chief minister Shiremen transmitted an order for Director of Imperial Sacrifices Aruqun and others to escort the spirit tablets of the ancestral temple side chambers north together with the heir apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Left chief minister Shiremen transmitted an order for director of imperial sacrifices Aruqun and others to escort the spirit tablets of the ancestral temple side chambers north together with the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 阿魯渾等即至太廟，與署令王嗣宗、太祝哈剌不華襲護神主畢，仍留室內。

translations.literal: When Aruqun and the others reached the Imperial Ancestral Temple together with acting director Wang Sicong and libationer Qara Buqa, they had finished escorting the spirit tablets but still left them within the chambers.
translations.idiomatic: When Aruqun and the others reached the Imperial Ancestral Temple together with acting director Wang Sicong and libationer Qara Buqa, they had finished escorting the spirit tablets but still left them within the chambers.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，白虹貫日。

translations.literal: On yichou day, a white rainbow pierced the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day a white rainbow pierced the sun.

sentences.zh: 罷內府興造。

translations.literal: Inner palace construction works were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace construction works were suspended.

sentences.zh: 詔淮王帖木兒不花監國，慶童為中書左丞相，同守京城。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Prince of Huai Temür Buhua to supervise the state, with Qingtong as left chief minister of the Secretariat, jointly guarding the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Prince of Huai Temür Buhua to supervise the state, with Qingtong as left chief minister of the Secretariat, jointly guarding the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，帝御清寧殿，集三宮后妃、皇太子、皇太子妃，同議避兵北行。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, the emperor attended at the Qingning Hall and gathered the three palaces' empresses and consorts, the heir apparent, and the heir apparent's consort to discuss avoiding warfare by fleeing north.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin day the emperor attended at the Qingning Hall and gathered the three palaces' empresses and consorts, the heir apparent, and the heir apparent's consort to discuss avoiding warfare by fleeing north.

sentences.zh: 失列門及知樞密院事黑廝、宦者趙伯顏不花等諫，以為不可行，不聽。

translations.literal: Shiremen and Bureau director Heisi and the eunuch Zhao Boyan Buhua remonstrated that this could not be done, but he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Shiremen and Bureau director Heisi and the eunuch Zhao Boyan Buhua remonstrated that this could not be done, but he would not listen.

sentences.zh: 伯顏不花慟哭諫曰：「天下者，世祖之天下，陛下當以死守，奈何棄之！

translations.literal: Boyan Buhua wept and remonstrated, saying: "The realm is the realm of Kublai; Your Majesty ought to defend it to the death — how can you abandon it!"
translations.idiomatic: Boyan Buhua wept and remonstrated, saying: "The realm is the realm of Kublai; Your Majesty ought to defend it to the death — how can you abandon it!"

sentences.zh: 臣等願率軍民及諸怯薛歹出城拒戰，願陛下固守京城。

translations.literal: We your subjects are willing to lead troops and people and all the keshig to go out of the city and resist battle; we beg Your Majesty to hold the capital firm."
translations.idiomatic: We your subjects are willing to lead troops and people and all the keshig to go out of the city and resist battle; we beg Your Majesty to hold the capital firm."

sentences.zh: 」卒不聽。

translations.literal: In the end he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he would not listen.

sentences.zh: 至夜半，開健德門北奔。

translations.literal: At midnight the Jiande Gate was opened and they fled north.
translations.idiomatic: At midnight the Jiande Gate was opened and they fled north.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，大明兵入京城，國亡。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengwu day; Ming forces entered the capital and the state perished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the gengwu day, Ming forces entered the capital and the state perished.

sentences.zh: 後一年，帝駐於應昌府，又一年，四月丙戌，帝因痢疾殂於應昌，壽五十一，在位三十六年。

translations.literal: One year later the emperor resided at Yingchang Prefecture; another year later, fourth month, bingxu day, the emperor died of dysentery at Yingchang, aged fifty-one, having reigned thirty-six years.
translations.idiomatic: One year later the emperor resided at Yingchang Prefecture; another year later, in the fourth month on the bingxu day, the emperor died of dysentery at Yingchang, aged fifty-one, having reigned thirty-six years.

sentences.zh: 太尉完者、院使觀音奴奉梓宮北葬。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Wanje and commissioner Guanyinnu escorted the coffin north for burial.
translations.idiomatic: Grand preceptor Wanje and commissioner Guanyinnu escorted the coffin north for burial.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，大明兵襲應昌府，皇孫買的裏八剌及后妃並寶玉皆被獲，皇太子愛猷識禮達臘從十數騎遁。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guimao day, Ming forces raided Yingchang Prefecture; the imperial grandson Maidilibala and the consorts together with jade treasures were all captured; the heir apparent Ayushiridara escaped with a dozen horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guimao day, Ming forces raided Yingchang Prefecture; the imperial grandson Maidilibala and the consorts together with jade treasures were all captured; the heir apparent Ayushiridara escaped with a dozen horsemen.

sentences.zh: 大明皇帝以帝知順天命，退避而去，特加其號曰順帝，而封買的裏八剌為崇禮侯。

translations.literal: The Ming emperor, considering that the emperor had known Heaven's mandate and withdrawn of his own accord, specially added to his title the designation Shundi, and enfeoffed Maidilibala as Marquis of Chongli.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming emperor, considering that the emperor had known Heaven's mandate and withdrawn of his own accord, specially added to his title the designation Shundi, and enfeoffed Maidilibala as Marquis of Chongli.
